RISK-3 (Low): assumptions listed as 'pending extraction review' — until assumptions are enumerated, scope of claim cannot be fully bounded.
RISK-4 (Low): seed=0 across all visible rows suggests deterministic seeding; confirm no unintended correlation across test variants.
notes: Numeric reproducibility is strong and supports promotion of the underlying data packet. However, publication gate should remain on HOLD until: (1) the mathematical claim is formally restated as a falsifiable proposition independent of CSV formatting, (2) explicit assumptions are extracted and attached, (3) float_risk medium is resolved or accepted with a documented tolerance rationale. Once those three items are satisfied, re-adjudication should yield auto-approve. Recommend fast-track re-review given the strong numeric foundation.
